description: [Experimental web session] List report namespaces of the web constructor (id, name, Reporting API prefix, e.g. Audience = ym:u:). With namespace_id: the metrics and dimensions (id, title; first 200 each) valid for custom widgets of that namespace. Uses the unofficial AppMetrica web API through a headless Chrome session: run `npx appmetrica-mcp login` once to log in to Yandex.

namespace_id.description: Namespace id, e.g. Audience, Revenue, Events

name: web_list_report_namespaces
